newsitem.title: JORDAN: Arafat flies to Abu Dhabi, Qatar.
newsitem.headline: Arafat flies to Abu Dhabi, Qatar.

text.p: Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat flew to Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates on Saturday, the Palestinian ambassador in Amman said.

"He wants to congratulate (UAE President) Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on his successful recovery and brief him on the latest developments in the Middle East peace process," ambassador Omar al-Khatib told Reuters.

The 78-year-old Sheikh Zaid had surgery on his neck vertebra in September in the United States. He spent two months convalescing in Spain and Morocco before returning to Abu Dhabi in time to celebrate his 30 years of rule on December 2.
Arafat would head for Qatar later on Saturday, Khatib said.
He said Arafat crossed into Jordan from Palestinian-ruled Jericho early on Saturday.

He was met at the Allenby Bridge by Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti and briefed him on the Palestinians' stalled talks with Israel on the long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.
Arafat, in a speech delivered on Friday by the PLO's United Nations observer, accused the Israeli government of "intransigence, procrastination and circumvention."
